metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a fly and somehow THIS poor soul disappeared?! Valorant logic
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like I just saw a bug
Enemy: probably uninstalling in disbelief
How did that even hit? No clue but I’m taking it
If your aim’s a happy accident, this one’s for you

Tap if your aim cheats harder than your brain!
